action_summary: The door classified only one of the two spellings an adapter refuses in. SystemExit(json.dumps({"error":true,...})) was parsed; RuntimeError("GUARD_KEY:detail") -- the repository's own SCREAMING_SNAKE convention -- fell through to FAIL__LIVE_CONTROLLER_EXECUTION, the status of an adapter bug, and the cause the exception named was discarded. Measured on main 6aa5dab with the 49-sentence advanced census: 7 of 13 refusals were that shape (POLYGLOT_REFUSED:CPP_NO_APPLICABLE_TRANSFORM x2, SQL_UNSUPPORTED_DDL_EDIT, PYPROJECT_ALREADY_PINNED_OR_EMPTY, NO_DECLARED_DEPENDENCY_TO_VENDOR, NO_FLAKY_TEST_DETECTED, TARGET_SYMBOL_COLLISION:add), and the same shape appears in the 18 ordinary sentences (DIAGNOSE_ARCHITECT_REFUSED:..., NOT_A_GIT_REPOSITORY:.). One predicate over the message now classifies the second spelling identically: a key is recognised, a traceback is not.
